summary: Iteration 5 (light-yellow default page bg, page_number_size control, layer controls for text/image blocks) verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 26/26 pass including new test_page_iter5.py (9 new tests covering Page defaults #FFF8DC + page_number_size=14, PUT-persistence of page_number_size 24/32, z_index persistence with negative values, default text block color #000000) plus regression suite test_books_api.py (8), test_assets_api.py (5), test_page_number_align.py (4). Frontend Playwright verified: new book's data-testid='page-color-fill-0' computes rgb(255,248,220), data-testid='page-number-0' computes fontSize 14px, PagePanel first swatch is data-testid='page-color-#FFF8DC' with ring-2 ring-terracotta active class, clicking page-color-#F2E8D5 updates the fill to rgb(242,232,213) and persists via PUT, page-number-size-trigger Select changes page-number-0 fontSize to 32px when 'page-number-size-32' option clicked. Default text block color #000000 still holds (data-testid='text-color-trigger' label shows '#000000'). Layer controls: with two text blocks (second initially z 1), clicking layer-forward twice updates data-testid='layer-current-z' to 'z 3' and the Rnd outer wrapper inline style.zIndex='3' (computed=3); layer-to-back changes to 'z 0' (min(other=1)-1=0); layer-to-front changes to 'z 2'; layer-backward decrements by 1. Layer controls also apply to image blocks (z_index field shared via updateBlock).

issues: addPage (line 211) hard-codes background_color='#F9F6F0' for newly added pages instead of relying on backend Page() default '#FFF8DC' or being consistent with the new light-yellow theme. New pages added via 'Add Page' button appear paper-cream while page 1 created by backend is light-yellow. Iter-5 spec said default is light yellow — recommend changing addPage to omit background_color (let backend default apply on next save) or use '#FFF8DC' to keep consistency. Minor since user can change it.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Update Editor.jsx addPage() to set background_color='#FFF8DC' (or omit so backend default applies) for consistency with the new light-yellow default.
critical_code_review_comments: Editor.jsx is now ~895 lines (above 700 LOC guideline). PageCanvas, SpreadPlaceholder, PageThumbnail still inlined. Recommended extraction has been deferred again — pls schedule it.

Editor.jsx addPage() hard-codes background_color: '#F9F6F0' (line 211) — diverges from new backend default '#FFF8DC'. Existing books created before iter-5 also keep '#F9F6F0' first page; if you want them migrated, write a one-off migration. For new books this works because backend default applies, but the addPage path needs alignment.

changeLayer() in Editor.jsx (line 196) does Math.max(...zs)+1 / Math.min(...zs)-1 — unbounded; over many bring-to-front clicks the z values can grow without bound. Consider normalizing z-indices after each layer op (re-rank to 1..N).

BlockProperties.jsx layer button row uses ChevronsDown for 'send to back' and ChevronDown for 'send backward'; ChevronsUp for 'bring to front' and ChevronUp for 'forward'. The pairing is correct (chevrons-double = extreme, chevron-single = step). Icons + titles read well in screenshots.
PagePanel PAGE_NUMBER_SIZES list (10/12/14/16/18/20/24/28/32) is a sensible range but capped at 32 — users wanting very large numbered chapter pages will need to type it. Consider adding 36/48 too.

CanvasBlock.jsx zIndex prop uses typeof block.z_index === 'number' guard — correctly handles 0 and negative values for to-back semantics. Verified in DOM (inline style.zIndex='0' present after layer-to-back).

All layer testids exposed: layer-to-back / layer-backward / layer-forward / layer-to-front / layer-current-z — clean API for tests. Z label currently shows 'z N' as plain text inside a center-aligned 10px font-mono div which is small but readable.

Backend Page model now has page_number_size default 14, page_number_align default 'right', background_color default '#FFF8DC'. extra='ignore' in ConfigDict tolerates additional client fields gracefully — good.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Iter5_Book, TEST_Iter5_Yellow_Book, TEST_Iter5_B2, TEST_Iter5_Final, TEST_Iter5_F2 books during run. Pytest fixture cleans the iter5 book. UI-created books remain in DB; main agent or next agent can delete via DELETE /api/books/{id}. Non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-5 features all green. Key gotcha for next agent writing Playwright selectors: NEVER use [data-testid^='block-'] because BlockProperties panel has data-testid='block-properties-panel' which also matches — narrow to [data-testid^='block-'][data-testid$='-content'] or, better, read .style.zIndex from elements where you know they are actual Rnd wrappers (block-{uuid}). The Rnd library DOES forward style.zIndex to its outer wrapper div correctly. To verify zIndex DOM application use el.style.zIndex (not getComputedStyle.zIndex on the panel element). PagePanel swatches grid only renders when the right-tab-page tab is active — use data-testid='right-tab-page' (not generic 'button:has-text("Page")' which collides with bottom-left 'Add Page' button).
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The single iteration of a frontend test that failed during run was due to overly broad selector ([data-testid^='block-']) including block-properties-panel which has no inline zIndex — the actual Rnd wrappers carried correct zIndex='3' in style attribute. App behavior is correct.
